subject.statement: Elizabeth Holmes is currently in federal prison.

summary: Elizabeth Holmes was sentenced in November 2022 to 11 years and 3 months in federal prison and reported to serve her sentence in April 2023. As of February 2026, she has not been released or pardoned, so she remains incarcerated.
